scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names portal,service --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm run dev:portal" "npm run dev:service"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names portal,service,linshe --prefix-colors cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev:portal" "npm run dev:service" "npm run dev:linshe"
scripts.build: npm run build:portal && npm run build:service
scripts.test: npm run test:portal && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run lint
scripts.start:local: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names portal,service --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm run start:portal" "npm run start:service"
scripts.start:local:legacy: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names portal,service,linshe --prefix-colors cyan,green,magenta "npm run start:portal" "npm run start:service" "npm run dev:linshe"
scripts.deploy:local: npm run build && npm run start:local
